description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) and validation logic for creating booking inputs in a scheduling application, including classes for attendee details, booking details, routing, and specialized booking types (instant, recurring). It uses decorators for validation, API schema generation, and custom validation rules.

classes.name: BaseBookingAttendee
classes.description: Base class for attendee details including name, timezone, optional phone number, and language.

classes.name: CreateBookingAttendee
classes.description: Extends BaseBookingAttendee with optional email, with validation to ensure at least email or phone is provided.

classes.name: Routing
classes.description: Represents routing information for booking assignment, including response ID, team member IDs, and optional CRM details.

classes.name: CreateBookingInput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Main DTO for creating a booking, including start time, attendee info, location, metadata, and optional routing, recurrence, and verification details.

classes.name: CreateInstantBookingInput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Extends main booking input with an instant booking flag.

classes.name: CreateRecurringBookingInput_2024_08_13
classes.description: Extends main booking input with recurrence count for repeating bookings.

methods.name: RequireEventTypeIdentification
methods.description: Decorator factory that enforces that either eventTypeId or eventTypeSlug with username or teamSlug must be provided.

methods.name: RequireEmailOrPhone
methods.description: Decorator factory that enforces that attendee must have at least email or phone number.
